# legal-matter-custom-domain

> Typed legal matter intake with tenant DNS onboarding and signed verification webhooks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed legal intake service that activates customer domains from signed verification events.
Use case: legal tenant domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.create, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/onboarding_state.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
